exposure: Category of urgency for cesarean section (CS)
time of day (office hours vs. out of office hours)
Time of day (office hours vs. out of office hours)
cohort: 488 women who underwent cesarean section at a single tertiary general hospital between August 2013 and June 2014
finding: The majority of cesarean deliveries were performed within the recommended DDI based on urgency, with time of day, surgeon experience, and history of previous CS influencing both DDI and total surgery duration.
